name: Shikigami Chunin

entries.name: Paper Expert
entries.text: You always have paper-based ninja tools to use.

entries.name: Papercraft
entries.text: When you use a paper-based ninja tool, its save DCs become your Ninjutsu save DC (already applied to affixed kunai).

entries.name: Caster Passive 1
entries.text: Effects that would prevent you from Chakra Molding all end at the end of each of your turns.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.text: The Shikigami Chunin may make two attacks with its currently equipped weapon.

entries.name: Kunai (Melee)
entries.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

entries.name: Kunai (Ranged)
entries.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 30/60 ft. Hit: (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

entries.name: Paper Bomb Affixed Kunai
entries.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 30/60 ft. Hit: (1d4 + 2) piercing damage. Regardless of the attack result, all creatures within 10 feet of the target creature (including the target creature) must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 8d4 fire damage on a failure, or half as much damage on a success. If this attack hits the target creature, the target creature makes its saving throw with disadvantage.

entries.name: Flash Tag Affixed Kunai
entries.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 30/60 ft. Hit: (1d4 + 2) piercing damage. Regardless of the attack result, all creatures within 10 feet of the target creature (including the target creature) must make a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, a creature gains the Blinded condition until the end of its next turn and gains 1 rank of Dazzled. If this attack hits the target creature, the target creature makes its saving throw with disadvantage.

notes: The Strength modifier is printed as -11; corrected to -1.
